review: Si Rodion is a hybrid user of Poise and Rupture; and just like Si Gregor, she is more suited for Poise teams, as her “addition” to the Rupture team is lackluster. Let’s first talk about her unique statuses, starting with Serpent Arm which she gains from her Defensive Skill, Skill 2 and Skill 3. At turn end, it gives Rodion 3 Poise Potency and 2 Poise Count.If the target is affected with Rupture she will gain an additional 5 Poise Potency on base skill use. This status can stack up to 3 times and is reduced by 1 at turn end. Her Second mechanic is Deathrite [Venom]. It is inflicted upon using Skill 2 and 3. It inflicts 1 Offense Level Down and 1 Defense Level Down upon getting Rupture triggered by a critical hit (up to 3 times per turn).
